title: Inconsistent parse results from simple ambiguous grammar
author: mcarpenter

comments.author: MegaIng
comments.body: Does this still happen with the latest master? (`pip install git+https://github.com/lark-parser/lark`)

comments.author: mcarpenter
comments.body:
Yes, it does still happen. (`pip list` reports 1.2.0, I still get two different results).

I also see discussion https://github.com/lark-parser/lark/discussions/1288 and setting environment variable `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` does indeed yield consistent results (the second of those presented above). Similarly increasing the priority to `quantifier.2` also fixes it for me.

comments.author: erezsh
comments.body: @mcarpenter Try the latest master again. (you might need to uninstall lark first)
